name: retrieve_tank500_info
description: Retrieve Tank 500 vehicle information from the official owner's manual knowledge base (features, controls, safety systems, off-road capabilities, maintenance, technical data). The manual is in English; if retrieval quality is poor for a non-English query, retry with the query translated to English.

query.description: The question or topic about the Tank 500 to search for

name: compare_competitor
description: Compare a competitor vehicle against the GWM Tank 500. Returns structured specs for both vehicles. Preset catalog covers: Toyota Land Cruiser Prado, Land Rover Defender 110, Ford Explorer PHEV. For vehicles outside the catalog, it falls back to a live web search (results marked source=web_search).

competitor_name.description: Competitor vehicle name, e.g. 'Toyota Land Cruiser Prado', 'Defender 110'

aspects.description: Optional aspects to focus on: dimensions, powertrain, offroad, price, selling_points

name: web_search
description: Search the web for current information such as local pricing, promotions, launch dates, and market news. Use for anything time-sensitive that is not in the owner's manual.

market.description: Optional target market to scope the search: de (Germany), uk (United Kingdom), it (Italy)

name: book_test_drive
description: Book a Tank 500 test drive / register a sales lead. Collect the customer's name, contact (phone or email), country, and preferred date before calling. Returns a confirmation ID.

country.description: Customer country: de, uk, or it

name: get_dealer_info
description: Get GWM dealer information (name, city, address, phone) for Germany, the United Kingdom, or Italy.

country.description: Country code: de, uk, or it
